name.pt-BR: São Luís e Santa Zélia Martin

prayerExcerpt.en-US: "I want to become a saint; it will not be easy."

meta.face: Two clearly different people from their photographs. Louis (left): a man of about fifty with a LONG face and a HIGH, DOMED, BALD crown, short dark hair left only at the sides and back; a broad smooth forehead, deep-set, light, steady eyes under straight brows, a long straight nose, a FULL, dense dark-brown beard and moustache streaked with grey, trimmed to a rounded point below the chin; a calm, kindly gaze. Zélie (right): a woman of about forty-four with a BROAD face and a SQUARE, firm jaw — wide cheekbones, level dark brows over steady dark eyes set rather wide, a straight, firm nose, a wide, straight mouth closed in the hint of a smile, a firm chin; dark-brown hair parted in the centre and smoothed flat over the ears into a low knot; no veil; her gaze on the viewer, frank and warm.
meta.basis: Their photographs of about 1875 (Commons, 'Louis Martin 1' and 'Zélie Martin 1'): Louis bald-crowned with a full beard, Zélie broad-faced and square-jawed with her hair smoothed flat and parted. His trade (watchmaker) and hers (Alençon lace) and the feast on their wedding anniversary, 12 July, are from fr.wikipedia.
meta.excerpt: St. Zélie Martin to her daughters Marie and Pauline, «Je veux devenir une sainte, ce ne sera pas facile», as quoted by the Sanctuary of Lisieux (La spiritualité de Louis et Zélie); our rendering (she died in 1877)

sources.title: Sanctuaire de Lisieux, La spiritualité de Louis et Zélie
